sources.name: MarkTechPost
sources.summary: PolyAI has introduced Dialog-RSN-1, a dialog model that perceives caller audio directly instead of reading an ASR transcript. It fuses turn-taking, speech recognition, function calling, and response generation into a single audio-native model, keeps TTS separate so the output voice stays controllable, and runs as a request-based LLM rather than an always-on stream. PolyAI reports sub-300ms responses in live deployments. The post PolyAI Releases Dialog-RSN-1: An Audio-Native Dialog Model That Fuses Turn-Taking, Speech Recognition, Function Calling, And Response appeared first on MarkTechPost .
